responsibility: Implements LTO streaming of GCC’s interprocedural symbol table and callgraph data. This file owns the encoder that assigns stable references to symtab nodes in a partition, tracks whether function bodies or variable initializers must be emitted, and serializes/deserializes cgraph nodes, varpool nodes, call edges, and related optimization summaries such as clone and parameter-adjustment information. It sits at the IPA/LTO boundary, consuming GCC’s cgraph/symtab structures and producing or reconstructing the symtab, edge records, and cgraph optimization-summary sections used by WPA and LTRANS.
